Great news for every fan of tower defense games! The full version of Lesson Learned will be available on May 29, 2024, on Steam and Xbox!

Watch the teaser announcing the date of Lesson Learned:

https://youtu.be/RC2FGmXwU6E

notes.title: Bakery Simulator delivery patch!
notes.notes:
Dear Bakers,

We have not forgotten about you!
We are sorry you had to wait a long time for this update, we understand your bitterness. 
Like always we wanted to make sure that patch does not bring new issues, so we had to test it thoroughly. Therefore, now we are proud to present you the latest update to our game! 
We hope you will like our new delivery system!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34508314/dfcfe5c5866738448cc34f8382f6cb915fd905fc.png

Before you start playing the newest version of the game, we highly recommend resetting your profiles for maximum benefits from the patch, due to the game's save system structure. Otherwise, we do not guarantee the correct running of the game, due to interference in the game system. 
Warning! After resetting your profile, you will lose all progress and have to start over.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34508314/ee4df04746cd4c4a80b8497bfb8a4084f8fa4e60.gif

Patch 1.3.4

Changes:
- Change in the tutorial: improved steps requiring the use of PLUCK and TRASH CAN, changed the amount of recognized bad ingredient in the bowl to 1g from 5g. 
- Change in mechanics: Courier. Courier available from the completion of the tutorial. Swapping the courier unlocking perk for a discount for deliveries. Basic courier costs change from 10% of the cost of the order to 5%. The first upgrade - 3% of the cost of the order. The second upgrade - 2% of the cost of the order. 
- Change in mechanics: time for deliveries. Expanding the delivery times x2 to avoid time pressure.
- Changed the amount of money when starting the game from 5000 to 1000.
- Change in the driving mechanics, new driving system has been implemented for both small car and truck, changing the driving aspect into more arcade-like. 
- Changed the camera angle in the City to top view. It is possible to adjust the field of view by scrolling the scroll of the mouse up or down. 
- Changed delivery points markers to make the more visible.
- Muffins: small and large forms can be thrown from the tray straight into the trash can. 
- Change in mechanics: muffins. Added LMB hold option to streamline the addition of muffin papers to trays and pouring mass in one fell swoop.
- Machine improvements: Improved Rounder Divider performance.
Save system: Removed crashes that could cause progress to be removed. 

Fixes:
- Fixed bigger performance issues on the City level, the level should run smoothly on the recommended setup even with graphic settings set to „very high”.
- Fixed issues with FPS loss, providing more stability on all tiers of bakery and City level. 
- Fixed texture and lighting issues in certain districts of the City level. 
- Fixed game crashes on deliveries. 
- Fix for loss of input on USB devices.
- Fix: The trigger on the red tray in the rounder divider is too small.
- Fix: The bowl from the large mixer does not respond to the reset of the position.
- Fix: After the reset of the position, the largest bowl on the cart does not detach from the player. Also added resetting the position to the default.
- Fix: Fixed problem with disappearing slots on tables.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34508314/8dd191ab45b17881e4d4018659b527fb992ac17c.png

For those who have not had the opportunity to experience the pleasure of baking, until 07.07.2022 10:00 AM PDT everyone will have the opportunity to buy Bakery Simulator at a bargain price with a 30% discount!
 
Those who have already bought Bakery Simulator also get something - great discounts on Gaming Factory games up to 90% - https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/gamingfactory/#browse

Thank you for playing Bakery Simulator!

notes.title: Bakery Simulator delivery patch incoming!
notes.notes:
Dear Bakers,

We are still working on a final patch that will introduce a new delivery system and fixes. We know that you are all waiting for this, we want to make sure everything works perfectly. We plan to release this patch at the end of this month. At the moment, we are fixing the codes to make sure that all saves will works properly, but of course we will recommend that you start the game from scratch so that you can enjoy it to the fullest.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34508314/737f3ad385d4897fa9bd4df9794f2edf0e4acaed.png

We've received a lot of feedback about the delivery system, unfortunately most of you didn't enjoy it. That's why we decided to change it, we are aware that it's Bakery Simulator, not a delivery simulator but there was no point to delete the ready content from the game. Below, we would like to present you a little sneak peak of the upcoming update, we hope that you enjoy it! Of course, in addition to the new driving system, there will be bug fixes and improved optimization.

https://i.imgur.com/5pxZg9d.gif
We've implemented a new driving system for both the small car and truck, changed the driving aspect into a arcade-like minigame! To avoid the time pressure, we will have doubled the delivery time.

https://i.imgur.com/HgrVQMz.gif
The camera view will be changed to isometric view. Additionally, it will be possible to adjust the field of view by scrolling the scroll of the mouse up or down. The delivery points markers will be more visible.

https://i.imgur.com/uxrCblx.gif
The delivery car now has better driving feeling, so this minigame will be more enjoyable to the players who will want to do the deliveries, the curier persk stays in place, so some of you will be able to skip the delivery.

Thank you for playing Bakery Simulator!
Gaming Factory team.
 
Join our Discord and discuss with our Gaming Factory team here:

notes.title: New patch announcement
notes.notes:
Dear Bakers,
Once again, we want to thank you all for the support and commitment you have provided us.
You showed us how a wonderful community you are, thanks to you we got a lot of feedback and suggestions! We are working hard on our game, we try to make sure that each of you can find something for yourself.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34508314/3341e9192da26f327c63d59cc65ccaa694cad85f.png

New delivery system!
In the upcoming patch we decided to change the delivery system, we want to make it more fun and enjoyable for the players. We changed the driving model and the view, now the players will have a top view with the possibility of zooming.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34508314/0c9dffe0a498934db148b5503f0d6ae151a8c6e4.png

We have new ideas on how to spice up the city in the game. We are also constantly fixing the most popular bugs and performance of the entire game so that you can all enjoy our game! Additionally, we are listening to your suggestions and the economy will be slightly changed at the beginning of the game so that it is not too easy. 

Patch will be ready soon, we want to make sure that it will work fine for all of you. We will inform about this, please be patient.

Remember to join our special contest!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34508314/4c3839cb5954a6280c139264cc0ed5823eb6618c.png

The steps to take part are very easy:
[olist]
 Take a screenshot of a scene/machine/pastry in the Bakery Simulator.
 Recreate the screenshot in real life (any artistic form is fine - as long as it can be used as a picture).
 Create a file showing the screenshot and the art you’ve made.
 Post them to our Steam Community thread from your Steam account or on our contest dedicated Discord channel - #🎁contests-and-giveaways
[/olist]
The giveaway includes 5 keys each for Train Station Renovation and Castle Flipper!
Please submit the works between May 17th and May 31th 2022.

Thank you for playing Bakery Simulator!

notes.title: Bakery Simulator post-release patch!
notes.notes:
Dear Bakers,

We have worked our buns off to deliver this highly anticipated patch, we hope that it will meet your expectations. We are sorry that it took so long but we wanted to make sure that patch does not bring new issues. We are satisfied with our work, we hope that playing our game will make you feel the same level of enjoyment!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34508314/3ff631f53a7f9062bc59c748421bccadcf534982.png

Before you start playing the newest version of the game, we highly recommend resetting your profiles for maximum benefits from the patch, due to the game's save system structure. Otherwise, we do not guarantee the correct running of the game, due to interference in the game system. 
Warning! After resetting your profile, you will lose all progress and have to start over.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34508314/ee4df04746cd4c4a80b8497bfb8a4084f8fa4e60.gif

Patch 1.2.8 

Changes:
- Change in the tutorial: improved steps requiring the use of PLUCK and TRASH CAN, changed the amount of recognized bad ingredient in the bowl to 1g from 5g. 
- Change in mechanics: Courier. Courier available from the completion of the tutorial. Swapping the courier unlocking perk for a discount for deliveries. Basic courier costs change from 10% of the cost of the order to 5%. The first upgrade - 3% of the cost of the order. The second upgrade - 2% of the cost of the order. 
- Change in mechanics: time for deliveries. Changing the time to longer deliveries to avoid time pressure.
- Closing the exit to the city, using only the courier for deliveries.
- City exit widget (tutorial) - graying out and blocking the "Call for delivery" button.
- Raise the amount of money when starting the game from 400 to 5000$
- City exit widget: hover on the grayed out "move to city" button causes the appearance of a pop-up with the under construction sign.
- Muffins: small and large forms can be thrown from the tray straight into the garbage.
- Change in mechanics: muffins. Added LMB hold option to streamline the addition of muffin papers to trays and pouring mass in one fell swoop.
- Machine improvements: Improved Rounder Divider performance.
- Save system: Removed crashes that could cause progress to be removed. 

Fixes:
- Fix for loss of input on USB devices.
- Fix: The trigger on the red tray in the rounder divider is too small.
- Fix: The bowl from the large mixer does not respond to the reset of the position.
- Fix: After the reset of the position, the largest bowl on the cart does not detach from the player. Also added resetting the position to the default.
- Fix: Fixed problem with disappearing slots on tables.

About game crashes:
Remember that in case of ingame crashes, you should provide us with a DxDiag of your machine (just press the Windows button, type in "dxdiag" and save all details) along with all files zipped from your game folder: C:\Users\USERNAME\AppData\Local\BakerySimulatorFull
All other additional info, such as issue descriptions, steps to reproduce it and a video would be greatly appreciated. Please send it at: help@bakerysimulator.eu

We also have a request to save the logs communicated by Unreal Crash Handler and attach to the bugs along with the packed saved folder.

Once again we want to apologize to you all dear Bakers for any inconvenience related to our game. There is more work to be done and we are aware of that. 

Thank you for playing Bakery Simulator!
Gaming Factory team.

notes.title: Bakery Simulator - Important Announcement - Release Date
notes.notes:
Hello Bakers!

Release date for Bakery Simulator has been delayed.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34508314/d225566cd83436fc7d7aafe71c957b4799cc7493.png

We understand that Bakery Simulator is expected by many players and we know that you have high expectations for the title. As we want to meet or even exceed those expectations we want to make sure the game is polished up to the highest degree! As we don't want to make any concession regarding the quality of the game and its features we've decided to delay the release date and spend the extra time on bugfixing and polishing the existing game mechanics. 

We'll be informing about new release date as soon as it's decided.

As we said previously the full version of Bakery Simulator will be quite different from the demo itself - there are many features that will be available in the full game that were absent in the demo and we want to make sure that those features work flawlessly to maximize your fun with the title. 

We hope you'll have a blast managing your very own Bakery and we stay committed to our work - creating an amazing and fun game for you is our objective number one! 

We also appreciate your support and understanding in this matter. Thank you! 

We'll be back with more information soon - including new date of release.

Best regards,
Bakery Simulator Team

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34508314/3275740acc70c627275e89ee73f2cec9575f4e27.png

notes.title: Bakery Simulator - Devlog #78 “Mini-games update!”
notes.notes:
Hello Bakers!

Do you remember the mini-games we've been showcasing few weeks ago? Let's discuss some changes we've introduced to them!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34508314/3907a571f9d6e96f4fbeaf5be267b5af22deacf0.png

As you might remember from our previous devlogs the game will feature a particular set of mini-games that will pop-up during the dough formation part of the baking process. Depending on the type of the product you want to bake those minigames will be different and will feature a different game mechanic. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34508314/9a403b67dd2c5cb6336dfd4a61d001bfd8f19bf3.jpg

Recently we've spent some time on making sure that the mini-games stay interesting and fun - we've decided on updating some of them to maximize the fun you will have when you play the game. On the screenshot above you can see one such updated minigame and how it looks like now. We've decided on sort-of quick time event - you will have to press the appropriate button in the right moment to cut the dough appropriately. Of course, image can "only" say a thousand words - when you'll have the chance to play it yourself you'll be the best judge of it! 

Thank you for your thoughts and feedback - until next time!

Best regards,

Bakery Simulator team

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34508314/3275740acc70c627275e89ee73f2cec9575f4e27.png
